notes.recognition: A calm mineral grazer reads immediately at 72 px without looking like combat art.
notes.agency: Its lowered head creates a readable pause-or-approach encounter, though player choice depends on surrounding UI.
notes.specificity: Basalt hide and translucent leaf plates extend the established Glassroot material language.
notes.restraint: The silhouette uses one pale botanical accent and no effects clutter.
notes.continuity: Muted stone, soft cyan growth, and gentle proportions fit the exploration tone.
notes.reusability: A complete horizontal silhouette works as a board encounter and card crop.
notes.accessibility: Leaf mass and animal contour remain distinct without hue.
